attributes.reason: C-0193/C-0202 assert cluster-wide admission posture (privileged / HostProcess containers) against bare Namespace manifests. The stack's own kyverno-policies component IS that admission control (verify-platform-signature; PSS restricted labels arrive with each application), and a Namespace object cannot itself satisfy the control.

auth-proxy's Role lets kyverno's background controller read and write Secrets in the auth-proxy namespace only, so its generate rule can mint each proxy instance's client and cookie secrets once (components/auth-proxy/common/secrets-policy.yaml). The grant is the mechanism, scoped to one namespace; the chart's own role grants kyverno no Secret access.
